title: Montserrat and Best of Barcelona tour including Sagrada Familia.
text: Highly recommend.  Montserrat is impressive to see and our guide showed us so many of the highlights of Barcelona.  We ended with Sagrada Familia tour on our own and it is a must see.  Our guide Alex did a great job driving and guiding.
author: Trip45490402491

title: First none cruise ship excursion or transfer. Great experience
text: Booked on line, post cruise tour.  Easy pick up outside cruise ship terminal.  Our luggage and carry on secured and keep in vehicle. Wonderful guide, great comfortable van, dropped off at hotel.  First excursion booked not with cruise line.  Well worth it. Must see Montserrat.
author: andrefH2239VX

title: Barcelona Private Tour
text: Four of us were picked up from the cruise port for our private tour right on time by our wonderful guide Lydia and our driver, David. After loading all our luggage in the van, we began our trip to Montserrat.  This tour was an absolutely perfect way to begin our time in Barcelona. Montserrat was amazing as well as the Barcelona city tour. Lydia was a wonderful guide and David was an expert driver.  I was not feeling well, so Lydia and David went the extra mile in locating a pharmacy so I could get some medicine.  Lydia was very patient and empathetic with my husband and I walking a bit more sl
author: peaker79

title: Could not be Better!
text: Very efficient. Pick up at Port was very convenient and got us out of that crowd in a timely manner.  Hotel pickup eliminates stress of getting to meeting point on time.  Tour guide, Christian, was extremely knowledgeable and clearly loves Barcelona.   He gave us two restaurant recommendations that worked out extremely well.  The information shared getting to Montserrat I believe was unique and appreciated.  I would book again as this is my second time using Barcelona Day Tours already.
author: J8099TVmartins

title: Wonderful experience
text: We were picked up at the port. Our guide, Alex was great. It was busy once we got closer to Montserrat so we got out and walked a little. Alex managed to find us and give us our tickets. We arranged a meeting time and place after we were done in Montserrat. We drove back to Barcelona and then toured around seeing all the highlights. Alex was wonderful, knowledgeable and we had a fabulous time. He dropped us and our luggage off at our hotel at the end of the day. Highly recommend Spain Day Tours!!
author: juliepB5060VZ

title: Barcelona and Montserrat
text: Had a wonderful day with guide.  Picked us up from the cruise port and we did Montserrat and Barcelona tour and then dropped us off at our hotel.  There were 4 of us and plenty of room in the car along with all our luggage.
author: cleoruby

title: Wonderful
text: Was a lovely day! Our guide (Marta), our driver (Wilfred) were amazing. They took very good care of us. Marta was a wealth of knowledge about the area, the places we visited and life in Barcelona in general.
author: Alex_F

title: Great excursion to Montserrat and around Barcelona!
text: Cristina was a great guide. She was very knowledgeable!  Also VERY helpful. While we were at Montserrat, I received a phone call that I mistakenly took the wrong suitcase when disembarking the cruise ship earlier that morning. Cristina was VERY helpful with getting me back to my hotel to drop off the suitcase to the rightful owners. She helped make a bad situation so much easier.  The sites she showed us were amazing and I thank her and the tour company for helping make the day much easier than it could have been!
author: Susan_E

title: A busy wonderful day
text: Dress in layers,  wear comfortable shoes and bring a snack and water. It is a very busy day and worth every minute. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and had everything timed out perfectly.  He was a wealth of knowledge and made the day very enjoyable.  So rest up and get ready for a great day!
author: Kathy_M
